content.comment_body: Hello, I'm interested in knowing the connection limits for a networked system. My setup includes: [product_name] [version_no] Master, [product_name] [version_no] Slave, [product_name] [product_name] operator device, and a web interface connected to the master unit. Currently, I can't access the parameterization section needed to complete setup on the web server page.
Could you clarify what you mean by this?
I mean the 'Parameterization' option is greyed out—I can't select it at all.
Which software version are you using? What exact [product_name] do you have? Please specify the order number. Also, which [product_name] have you selected in the device list?

I've updated everything to the latest versions for [product_name] [version_no]: software v[version_no], web editor v[version_no], firmware [version_no], [product_name] [version_no]. Right now, I don’t have access to the complete code but will describe my situation as clearly as possible. I've built a system with two [product_name] controllers in a network project since I maxed out the number of digital and analog inputs on the first one (including all possible expansion modules). There's also a [product_name] operator device in the cabinet for managing parameters and viewing alarms. I've made a web page with the editor to display system status. Everything functioned correctly until I needed to change parameters remotely (i.e., adjust values inside logic blocks from afar). To integrate this in the web editor, variables must be mapped in the parameterization section, but I can't select it currently. I appreciate your help.
I'm not familiar with this issue. I also use [product_name] [version_no], software v[version_no], and web editor v[version_no] without any problems. If possible, please upload your software project.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face a problem where the parameterization menu is disabled and cannot be accessed within the [product_name] configuration software for a networked [product_name] system. This prevents mapping variables for web server usage and blocks remote parameter adjustments. Other users with similar software and device versions do not report the same issue, suggesting the root cause may lie in the specific user's settings or project details rather than being a general software issue.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to access the parameterization section in the configuration software to assign variables for web server setup, enabling the ability to change parameters remotely.
